theme: A clear deck, a few lines to tie off ashore.
greeting: Good afternoon, Dan — nothing on the calendar today, just the Adriatic and the last stretch of the charter. The only real pulls are a handful of shore-side bookings worth closing while you have signal, and a read for tomorrow's NACD call.

needsAttention.title: Lock Saturday's Cavtat ground moves
needsAttention.detail: The Remisens hotel is booked, but the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, the early bag hold, and the 5:15 AM checkout for Sunday's flight all need arranging from shore before Saturday — charter connectivity thins out once you are underway.

needsAttention.title: NACD programming committee prep
needsAttention.detail: Larissa's reminder for the 9/16 1:00 PM ET committee call carries the latest programming report — skim it beforehand so you arrive holding the agenda rather than opening it cold.

needsAttention.title: Florida arrival still has two gaps
needsAttention.detail: Two p1 items are past due for your Sept 20 TPA landing: the Sept 20-22 St Pete lodging gap and the Sept 20-Oct 5 full-size SUV. Landing jet-lagged on a Sunday without both booked is the thing to avoid.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV, a day past due
needsAttention.detail: The 'book this week' full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week slipped by one day; holiday inventory there sells out early, so a refundable hold now removes the whole risk at no cost.

flagged.title: myFICO credit report alert
flagged.detail: Multiple changes flagged to your TransUnion report with an updated score — a look once you are back on solid wifi.

flagged.title: Philip hoping to connect before Saturday
flagged.detail: An old friend wrote wanting to get together; he leaves Saturday for two weeks in the Med, so a short reply closes the loop.

flagged.title: Independent Managers Club intro forming
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano is lining up a call with Mercer/Marsh's Ryan Moore and Chie Mitsui on the pension-advisory research — you are cc'd, nothing owed yet.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters — NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, Dex reminders, the Midcoast Villager, and a couple of subscription notices.

recipe.title: Borlotti beans with sautéed baby kale
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans into the season's harvest and cooler evenings.

tasks.title: Check for a better St Pete Airbnb before the Sept 18 charge
Confirm the Nautilus return transfer to the airport
Disney tickets for the Sept 26-27 Orlando weekend

acts.line: An empty calendar and open water — no meetings anywhere on today.
Worth spending any signal you catch on Saturday's Cavtat transfers before the charter's connectivity thins.
The one fixed point ahead is tomorrow's NACD New England programming call at 1 — the report reads first.
